question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched position at the apex of the Chinese Communist Party drives the overwhelming trader consensus against removal before 2027. At age 73, he has eliminated potential rivals through sustained military and elite purges, abolished presidential term limits, and retained unchallenged authority over the Central Military Commission and Politburo Standing Committee. Preparations for the 21st Party Congress in late 2027 focus on installing loyalists and extending his tenure into a fourth term rather than engineering an exit, with no credible signs of internal revolt or health-driven succession pressure emerging in recent months. While abrupt developments such as a serious medical event or unforeseen elite realignment could still intervene, the current structure of power and absence of viable alternatives underpin the market’s assessment of continuity.
